name: evidence_floors
definition: Minimum replication for a load-bearing headline result, read by scripts/gate_artifact.sh (REQUIRE_EVIDENCE_ADEQUATE=1) at ship. The isolated ship-time power critic (playbooks/review.md §2d) states the seed/cell counts it found against the delivered artifacts; the gate checks them against these floors. A negative/impossibility headline faces the SAME floor as a positive one.
change_policy: Tier-2 memo. Tune to the task hour-0 — usually upward; a result thinner than these floors is an unfinished experiment, not a caveat.
